releaseNotes: 修复皮肤同时应用到 WorkBuddy、豆包和 Codex 时未完整生效的问题；统一三端输入区为单一圆角外壳，移除工作区、工具栏和历史列表的多余边框；挂件动作改为按皮肤配置并支持全宽往返掉头，同时修复 WorkBuddy 重复挂件。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes incomplete multi-agent theme application; reduces WorkBuddy, Doubao, and Codex composers to one rounded shell without redundant workspace, toolbar, or history borders; scopes mascot motion per skin with full-width turnaround; and removes duplicate WorkBuddy mascots.
